title.context: Savings tab: heading of the debts section (loans, mortgage, cards).

new.context: Savings tab: button and sheet title for adding a debt.

add.context: New debt sheet: the submit button.

empty.message: A mortgage, a loan, a card or instalments: add them to see when you'll be free of them and what's left of your net worth.
empty.context: Savings tab: empty state of the debts section.

addFirst.context: Savings tab: button in the empty debts section.

loan.context: Debt kind: a cash or car loan.

installments.context: Debt kind: buying on instalments, often 0%.

namePlaceholder.context: New debt sheet: placeholder of the name field.

owedToday.context: New debt sheet: label of what's still owed.

owedTodayHelp.message: What's left to pay back, as the bank shows it.
owedTodayHelp.context: New debt sheet: help under 'Owed today'.

rate.context: Debt sheet: label of the yearly interest rate.

rateHelp.message: The actual rate (or RRSO); empty or 0 for 0% instalments.
rateHelp.context: Debt sheet: help under the rate. RRSO is the Polish APR; keep it in Polish.

payment.context: Debt sheet and page: the monthly instalment.

paymentHelp.message: The instalment, or what you pay off a card each month.
paymentHelp.context: Debt sheet: help under the monthly payment.

paidOff.context: Debt sheet: button that archives a debt once it's paid off.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete {name} and its history for good? To keep the history, mark it paid off instead.
deleteConfirm.context: Debt sheet: delete confirmation. {name} is the debt's name.

perMonth.context: Debt card: the monthly payment, short. {amount} is formatted money.

cleared.context: Debt card/page: nothing is owed any more.

until.context: Debt card: when it'll be paid off at its own pace. {month} is 'March 2029'.

never.context: Debt card: the payment doesn't cover the interest, so it never ends.

showPaidOff.context: Savings tab: toggle that shows debts marked paid off.

hidePaidOff.context: Savings tab: toggle that hides debts marked paid off.

planTitle.context: Savings tab: heading of the debt payoff plan card.

avalanche.context: Payoff plan: the avalanche strategy, highest interest first. Keep it short.

snowball.context: Payoff plan: the snowball strategy, smallest balance first. Keep it short.

avalancheHelp.message: Every debt gets its payment; the extra goes to the one with the highest interest. It costs the least overall.
avalancheHelp.context: Payoff plan: what the avalanche strategy does.

snowballHelp.message: Every debt gets its payment; the extra goes to the smallest one. Quick wins keep you going.
snowballHelp.context: Payoff plan: what the snowball strategy does.

extra.context: Payoff plan: label of the extra amount put towards debts each month.

planFree.one: Debt-free in {month}, in {count} month, with {interest} of interest on the way.
planFree.other: Debt-free in {month}, in {count} months, with {interest} of interest on the way.
planFree.context: Payoff plan result. {month} is 'March 2029' (nominative in Polish), {count} the months, {interest} formatted money.

planBetter.one: {count} month sooner and {amount} less interest than paying each on its own.
planBetter.other: {count} months sooner and {amount} less interest than paying each on its own.
planBetter.context: Payoff plan: what the plan gains over paying each debt separately.

planLess.message: {amount} less interest than paying each on its own.
planLess.context: Payoff plan: the interest saved when it isn't sooner.

planNever.message: At these payments some debts never end: {names}. Their payment doesn't cover the interest; raise it or add extra.
planNever.context: Payoff plan warning. {names} lists debt names.

planNote.message: The order, and when each one is paid off. An estimate: interest is worked out monthly and rates change. The extra and the choice stay on this phone.
planNote.context: Payoff plan: note under the list.

update.context: Debt update sheet title. {name} is the debt.

updateShort.context: Debt page: button that opens the update sheet.

modeInstalment.context: Debt update: mode, this month's instalment paid. Keep it short.

modeOverpay.context: Debt update: mode, paid extra. Keep it short.

modeBalance.context: Debt update: mode, type the balance the bank shows. Keep it short.

instalmentPaid.context: Debt update: label of the instalment amount.

instalmentHelp.message: Of it, about {interest} is this month's interest; the rest comes off what's owed. Log the instalment as an expense too, if you haven't.
instalmentHelp.context: Debt update: help. {interest} is formatted money.

overpaid.context: Debt update: label of the overpayment.

overpaidHelp.message: All of it comes off what's owed.
overpaidHelp.context: Debt update: help under the overpayment.

bankBalance.context: Debt update: label of the balance typed from the bank.

bankBalanceHelp.message: The most accurate: the app's estimate is replaced by it.
bankBalanceHelp.context: Debt update: help under the bank balance.

date.context: Debt update: label of the date field.

willOwe.context: Debt update: the change it will make. Both are formatted money.

noteInstalment.context: Debt history: note on a balance after an instalment.

noteOverpay.context: Debt history: note on a balance after an overpayment.

noteBank.context: Debt history: note on a balance typed from the bank.

paidOffBy.context: Debt page: stat label, the month it ends.

doneText.message: Nothing owed any more. Mark it paid off in Edit to put it away.
doneText.context: Debt page: text once it's paid off.

neverText.message: This month's interest is {interest} and the payment {payment}: at this pace it never ends. Raise the payment or overpay.
neverText.context: Debt page: the payment doesn't cover the interest.

paceText.one: At this payment it's paid off in {month}, in {count} month, with {interest} of interest still to pay.
paceText.other: At this payment it's paid off in {month}, in {count} months, with {interest} of interest still to pay.
paceText.context: Debt page. {month} is 'March 2029', {count} months, {interest} formatted money.

interestNow.message: Interest this month: about {amount}. Every overpayment saves it from then on.

paidDown.context: Debt page: progress since the first balance. {date} is a long date.

history.context: Debt page: heading of the balance history.

historyEmpty.message: No balance yet: Update adds the first one.

deleteEntry.context: Debt page: label of the delete button on a history row.

gone.message: This debt isn't here any more.
gone.context: Debt page: opened for a deleted debt.
